name: Miss Longbow
description: A planeswalker with a longbow, from Skalla, who insists that Bolas is never sated.

timeline.summary: Attendees argue about surrender or hiding, and Vorel blames planeswalkers while the archer and Samut insist Bolas is never sated.
timeline.quote: There is literally nothing left of my world, Skalla, thanks to him.
